title: omnia_config.yaml
description: Omnia slurm and k8s config related parameters

cluster_name.description: Unique name for the slurm cluster.

nfs_storage_name.description: Name of the nfs storage in storage_config.yml

vast_storage_name.description: Name of the vast storage in storage_config.yml

skip_merge.description: Variable indicates whether a specific configuration file path under config_sources should be used as-is without merging

node_discovery_mode.description: Node hardware discovery mode. 'homogeneous' for group-based discovery, 'heterogeneous' for individual node discovery. Default: heterogeneous

node_hardware_defaults.description: Hardware specifications for homogeneous node groups. Key is group name (grp0-grp100 or SU1-SU100), value is hardware specs.

sockets.description: Number of CPU sockets per node

cores_per_socket.description: Number of CPU cores per socket

threads_per_core.description: Number of CPU threads per core

real_memory.description: Memory in MB (exact value to use in Slurm)

config_sources.description: Config can be a file path or inline mapping

service_k8s_cluster.description: List of service Kubernetes cluster configurations.

cluster_name.description: Unique name for the service Kubernetes cluster.

deployment.description: Indicates if Kubernetes will be deployed or not. Accepted values: true or false.

etcd_on_local_disk.description: Determines whether ETCD is deployed on local disk or NFS storage. When true, ETCD is deployed on local disk on all master nodes prioritizing BOSS card if available. When false, ETCD storage is provisioned using NFS. Default: false.

k8s_cni.description: Kubernetes SDN network. Accepted values: calico. Default: calico.

pod_external_ip_range.description: IP range used by the loadbalancer for assigning external IPs to Kubernetes services. Ensure the IP range is not assigned to any node in the cluster.

k8s_service_addresses.description: Kubernetes internal network for services. This network must be unused in your network infrastructure. Default: 10.233.0.0/18.

k8s_pod_network_cidr.description: Kubernetes pod network CIDR for internal communication. This network must be unused in your network infrastructure. Default: 10.233.64.0/18.

nfs_storage_name.description: Name of the NFS client server as mentioned in storage_config.yml. Used to set up the NFS provisioner on the K8s service cluster for PV provisioning.

csi_powerscale_driver_secret_file_path.description: Absolute file path for the CSI PowerScale driver secret.yaml file. Required when using Dell PowerScale storage with the Kubernetes cluster.

csi_powerscale_driver_values_file_path.description: Absolute file path for the CSI PowerScale driver values.yaml file. Required when csi_powerscale_driver_secret_file_path is provided.

k8s_crio_storage_size.description: Storage size for CRI-O container runtime. Specify in Gigabytes (e.g., 10G, 15G, 100G). Default: 10G.
